scene_logic.composition: Two very different dinosaurs standing back-to-back on a small, stylized grassy mound to see who is taller.
scene_logic.character_left: A tiny, bright-green Compsognathus standing on its tiptoes, stretching its neck as high as possible with a determined, funny expression.
scene_logic.character_right: A massive, friendly T-Rex sitting down or slouching comically to get closer to the tiny dino's level, looking over its shoulder with a curious, playful smile.
scene_logic.background: A simple, bright prehistoric park with soft rolling hills and a few 'bouncy' looking palm trees under a sunny sky.

typography.style: 3D thick, rounded block letters with a soft 'clay' texture.
typography.color: Bright fire-engine red (matching the branding of your other games).
typography.placement: Centered at the top, casting a soft shadow on the sky.

technical_parameters.lighting: Cheerful, even daylight with soft specular highlights on the dinosaurs' eyes.
technical_parameters.surface_finish: High-end 3D groom; satin-matte skin; no scales, no grit. Vibrant, saturated colors.
technical_parameters.negative_prompt: white background, realistic, scary, sharp teeth, grit, museum, humans, 90s CGI, grainy, all caps, blurry text.
